sky.qualification: Betelgeuse's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: The Sun is a point 168 parsecs away in the direction of the observer; the sphere is self-luminous and the scene's illumination direction is the viewing direction, not a light source on the star
provenance.qualification: Computed Betelgeuse Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
